Name: Shuzo (from Show by Rock) Replaces Sam (Content Patcher)
Author: waffletoast215
Description:
This mod replaces Sam's sprites and portraits with Shu☆Zo from the anime/game series Show by Rock!! Includes regular, beach AND winter versions! Trichronika's guitarist and vocalist has arrived in Stardew Valley! ☆

        -Every single Sam sprite has been replaced with the Dream☆Galaxy idol, Shu☆Zo! ☆
﻿-Replaces Sam's electric guitar playing animation with Shu☆Zo's Gold Mechanical Clock!
        -Replaces Sam's wedding outfit to Shu☆Zo's wedding outfit from the first Show by Rock game.
        -Replaces Sam's beach outfit with a blue one that matches Shu☆Zo's color scheme better.
        -Replaces some of Sam's dialogue!
        -NEW: adds winter clothes and compatibility with 1.6! These are based on his winter outfit from Fes a Live. 

1.5.0 update: dialogue is here! Most of Sam's dialogue has been edited to be specific to Shuzo. Some of Sam's dialogue still remains in lines about his family and some other misc lines. Both marriage dialogue and regular NPC dialogue is included!
1.6 update: fixed beach sprites not working. 
2.0 update: adds winter clothes and compatibility with 1.6. 

Use SMAPI/Content Patcher to use this mod!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271?tab=files&file_id=51404]You can use this mod to change his name to match!
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2668?tab=files&file_id=11023]Here is the UI mod shown [/url]in some of the example photos!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4154]Here is the clothing mod [/url]I am using in some screenshots!

Contains both edited Sam sprites and original sprites, all made by me. 
Most of the dialogue is rewritten Sam lines I've made to fit Shuzo. Some lines are his song lyrics from the anime (dubbed and subbed) and some lines are translations of his home screen lines from fes a live, translated by [url=https://twitter.com/artwaltzed]Kas[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/sixty_cats]sixty_cats![/url]
This is the first ever mod I've made myself. Enjoy! Please do not repost my sprites/use them in other projects without permission!
